The RMX911 is intended primarily for use with the time over current relays 
 types IKT 943 and the IDMT relays IKC911. It is designed to determine the 
 direction of earth fault in both solidly Grounded and ungrounded power system.

sections.text:
Preliminary Steps to Prepare for 
Relay Testing

items: This procedure is used to perform off load relay test.
The test is done for ( 50/51 & 67G ) as a one relay.
Review technical reference material: Manufacturer's manual.
Obtain copy of relay setting from field maintenance file.
Obtain outage for line protected by this relay.
Check that the bus and line disconnect switches are opened and tagged.

Inspect the CT secondary 
 circuits, the VT Miniature Circuit Breakers MCB'S, 
 and all cabling supplying the relay.
Use station drawing to isolate:
Breaker trip coils.
Breaker failure scheme associated with this relay.
Disturbance alarms and fault recorder associated with this relay.

sections.text:
Testing the Relay and 
Protection Outputs

items: Carefully follow these test procedure steps.

Verify the test results match the relay setting, if not consult technical 
 services.
Test trip all breakers associated with the relay.

Prior to Starting Testing Procedure(s) 
Ensure the Following Steps

items:
Look at the 
 EEHC panel nameplate and check that this EEHC system designation nameplate 
 agrees with the line that has been taken out of service for maintenance.

Check there 
 is no AC current from CT's by using a clip on ammeter.

Check there 
 is no AC voltage from VT's by using a voltmeter.

Connect 
 the xs92a test set with the relay as shown in Figure 1.

Ensure that the CT secondary is correctly short circuited and voltage teminals 
 supplying the relay is opened.
These connections must be made before starting test.

sections.text:
Test 
Trip all Breakers associated with the Relay

items: Reconnect Breaker trip coils.
Close only the circuit breakers associated with the relay.
Adjust the injection parameters to make trip.
Start injection and make sure all breakers are tripped.
Unplug the test set XS92a from the power source.
Remove the test leads from the relay and the test equipment.

Return the relay to the permanent settings as indicated in the maintenance 
 file.
This Completes the Test Procedure.

sections.text: Return Relay and associated Equipment to Service

items: Return relay to service by withdrawing the test plug handle from the relay.
Reconnect any equipment associated with the relay has been isolated:
Breaker trip coils.
Breaker failure scheme associated with this relay.
Disturbance alarms and fault recorder associated with this relay.
